1,977 | chairman = Jakub Dębiec (acting) | manager = [[Tomasz Kafarski]] | league = [[I liga]] | season = [[2025–26 I liga|2025–26]] | position = I liga, 11th of 18 | pattern_la1 = _adidasstriped24wr | pattern_b1 = _adidasstriped24wr | pattern_ra1 = _adidasstriped24wr | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = _adidasblackl | leftarm1 = ffffff | body1 = ffffff | rightarm1 = ffffff | shorts1 = ffffff | socks1 = ffffff | pattern_la2 = _adidasstriped24gfb | pattern_b2 = _adidasstriped24gfb | pattern_ra2 = _adidasstriped24gfb | pattern_sh2 = _adidastirocm24b | pattern_so2 = _adidaswhitel | leftarm2 = ffffff | body2 = ffffff | rightarm2 = ffffff | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | website = {{URL|https://pogongrodzisk.pl}} }} '''Pogoń Grodzisk Mazowiecki''' is a Polish [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Grodzisk Mazowiecki]], [[Masovian Voivodeship]]. They compete in the [[I liga]] in the [[2026–27 I liga|2026–27 season]]. Previously, their highest league tier was the [[II liga]], with their first promotion in 1958 (then known as the ''III liga'').{{cite web |url=http://www.90minut.pl/skarb.php?id_klub=284&id_sezon=97 |title=Skarb - Pogoń Grodzisk Mazowiecki |date= |website=90minut.pl |publisher= |accessdate=14 June 2021 |language=pl }} They were promoted to this level again after winning group I of the [[2020–21 III liga]], ensuring the promotion with two games left after beating [[Jagiellonia Białystok II]] 6–0.{{cite web |url=http://www.90minut.pl/news/312/news3125084-Pogon-Grodzisk-Mazowiecki-w-II-lidze.html |title=Pogoń Grodzisk Mazowiecki w II lidze |date= |website=90minut.pl |publisher= |accessdate=14 June 2021 |language=pl }}"}}
